availability_evidence.book_name: Compendiums on Regal Weapon Creation Pt. II
availability_evidence.book_facts: Current game-authored book explicitly lists14unfired molds, clay/sketch/Befouled Silk quantities and kiln firing sheet; it explicitly distinguishes components from finished weapons and says component schematics need not be scribed.
availability_evidence.historical_limit: Maintained RoF category and current book corroborate formulas and learning distinction; frozen per-formula May2013 numeric trivial/yield receipts unavailable.

restriction_review.container: 14wheel BagType21 and14kiln BagType22 formulas; actual10slot Pottery Wheel54257 and Kiln54254 guarded. Max6component units. Ordinary common components; no racial cultural kit substitution.
restriction_review.learning: must_learn0 and learned_by_item_id0 supported by explicit component exception in Compendium PtII; finished weapon scribing requirements are not relaxed.
restriction_review.nofail: Numeric trivials17 for firing and282–287 for unfired shaping; ordinary nofail0, no guaranteed-success evidence asserted.
restriction_review.salvage: Ordinary consumable metadata convention; no historical AA rate proof.
